scope: Read-only review of current ten-page screen, defense notes, builder, and rendered pages2/7/9. No PDF changes.
overall: The deck is legible and well organized. Its largest presentation problem is that bookkeeping detail occupies space needed to explain which business outcomes drive value. Extra accounting sophistication does not supply an investment edge.

judge_capital_explanation: I fund$1.25 of net operating investment for each additional$1 of annual modeled core-business sales. Working capital is included, and gross capital spending also replaces depreciating assets. With the modeled margins, this produces about23.5% incremental after-tax operating return at maturity. That is a competitive-durability judgment, even though the cash arithmetic is funded.
judge_return_explanation: The11.555% rate values operating cash, while the shareholder also owns cash and bears debt costs. The model’s intrinsic value grows10.94% annually fromend2026toend2030 after that financing bridge. The actual$52.22 purchase price and longer holding interval yield10.03%. This reconciles the rates; it does not establish attractive risk-adjusted upside or a price cushion.
investment_judgment: A moderate LONG is internally coherent as an accepted return choice. The valuation itself does not establish a compelling bargain. Raising confidence requires better evidence about the durable operating forecast or a better entry price, not another decimal place or a favorable discount-rate convention.
